room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; associated medical expenses subject to proportionate deduction if higher room taken

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: 20% co-pay applies to every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured

ped_waiting.note: 36 months for all PEDs except pre-existing disability (24 months) and HIV/AIDS (30-day initial wait only)

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, calculi, varicose veins etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days from discharge

day_care.note: All day care treatments covered under inpatient care section

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of Sum Insured as inpatient or day care

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (Annexure II List I)

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/non-instalment; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not renewals

portability.note: Portability to same product with other insurers as per IRDAI guidelines

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary, STDs, ART for HIV, stem cell storage, alternative therapies
